name: dsh-chat-image-lightbox
description: DSH plugin (DSH >= 2.0.14): full-screen chat image lightbox (zoom/pan/download/page), conversation-wide thumbnail grid with adjustable columns, hide/show with no blank space, lossless native-resolution TIFF/HEIC display, hotlink fallback, copy path & show in folder. 对话图片灯箱+可调列数缩略图网格+隐藏（不留空白）+TIFF 原像素无损+防盗链自动降级+复制路径/打开文件夹的 DSH 插件（DSH >= 2.0.14）。
